children: New Zealand's coming GDP data will likely show a sharp slowdown in 2Q, with growth nearly flatlining after the March quarter's 1% quarter-on-quarter growth, says Moody's Analytics in a note. Monthly indicators suggest that the economic recovery lost steam as higher fuel costs weighed on businesses and consumers, it says. Household purchasing power and confidence remain soft, and businesses are holding off on hiring and investing, it says. The GDP data are due Thursday. (monica.gupta@wsj.com)
